scripts.composer:install: npx wp-env run cli bash -lc 'cd /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/executive-signal-wordpress-theme && composer install'
scripts.lint:php: npx wp-env run cli bash -lc 'cd /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/executive-signal-wordpress-theme && vendor/bin/phpcs'
scripts.lint:php:fix: npx wp-env run cli bash -lc 'cd /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/executive-signal-wordpress-theme && vendor/bin/phpcbf'
scripts.lint:php:syntax: npx wp-env run cli bash -lc 'cd /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/executive-signal-wordpress-theme && find . \( -path "./dist" -o -path "./vendor" -o -path "./node_modules" -o -path "./assets/dist" \) -prune -o -name "*.php" -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l'
scripts.test:static: npm run build && npm run lint:php:syntax && npm run lint:php
scripts.test:php: npx wp-env run tests-cli bash -lc 'cd /var/www/html/wp-content/themes/executive-signal-wordpress-theme && vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml.dist'
scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:php
